mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average 20d return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market tightness that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand, which accelerates inflation and triggers preemptive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60d returns: SPX returns are positive in >60% of co-movement instances, or the Rank IC of the interaction term is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening supply capacity, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real GDP growth above 2.5% annualized in the current quarter signals strong aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth > 2.5%, or the mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that inflation is not being tamed, prompting market expectations of prolonged high rates and negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and stable FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 60d returns: SPX returns are positive in >60% of such cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment growth below 50k in a month signals weakening labor demand, which reduces wage pressures and inflation, leading to expectations of rate cuts and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth < 50k, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction and consumer spending signals robust demand, which accelerates inflation and leads to a Fed response that suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20d returns: SPX returns are positive in >60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
